scope: Real production dashboard runtime over ephemeral loopback TCP with live PostgreSQL-backed readiness/session-store traffic, fail-closed API auth load, HTTP latency/RPS/error metrics, CPU/heap/RSS/event-loop metrics and database behaviour.

contracts.productionRuntime: src/dashboard/server.ts startDashboard with the production middleware, routes, Socket.IO, Prisma and PostgreSQL session store
contracts.labIsolation: ephemeral port bound explicitly to 127.0.0.1; no external network or credentials
contracts.liveDatabase: STAGE50_REQUIRE_LIVE=1 requires DATABASE_URL and exercises /health/ready plus independent PostgreSQL probes
contracts.metrics: requests, RPS, p50/p95/p99/max, error rate, status codes, concurrency, CPU, heap, RSS, external/array buffers, event-loop p50/p95/p99/max and PostgreSQL pool/statistics
contracts.authUnderLoad: unauthenticated production /api/v2 path returns 401 fail-closed under concurrent load
contracts.artifact: stage50-artifacts/<exact-sha>.json in two mandatory independent CI jobs

residual: Exact-SHA artifacts from both mandatory CI jobs must be archived before audit promotion.

scopeBoundaries.stage51: Long-duration multi-sample soak is measured separately in Stage 51.
scopeBoundaries.stage67: Live Discord gateway and credentialed external-provider traffic require the owner-controlled production boundary.
